claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wide, diverse selection of colors and the vibrant color payoff.
Many reviewers note the glitter is only on the top layer and fades after the first use, which some find disappointing.
Several reviewers report the eyeshadow lasts a long time and stays on all day.
Multiple reviewers highlight the affordable price and good value.
Some reviewers mention that using an eyelid primer makes the colors show up more vibrantly.
